{{Quote|Let them laugh about ''that!'' And while they're reeling, our ''attack squadrons'' will rip them to pieces!|Unidentified Star Destroyer Captain|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 38">[[Star Wars (1977) 38|''Star Wars'' (1977) 38]]</ref>}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Star Destroyer captain''' was active during [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. He encountered a large [[Mecho-organic vessel|organic sentient vessel]] that called itself the [[Ship (sentient spacecraft)|Ship]], and upon firing at it, Ship released a number of [[anti-matter pod]]s that obliterated the captain's [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] as soon as they came in contact with it. All aboard were presumably killed.
